about.title: The Grass Florist Story | Artistry in Bloom
about.subtitle: Where uncompromising luxury meets exquisite natural botanicals
about.storyP1: Grass Florist was founded with a singular ambition: to elevate the gift of flowers into a profound sensory expression of devotion, celebration, and gratitude across Saudi Arabia.
about.storyP2: We source direct from premier high-altitude growers in Ecuador and sustainable Dutch glasshouses. Handled through our proprietary climate-monitored cold chain, our master florists arrange each stem by hand with architectural precision and timeless grace.
about.coldChainDesc: From greenhouse harvest to refrigerated transport and doorstep presentation, optimal temperature control preserves vibrant color and full fragrance for over a week.
